text:
Changed lldb/source/Plugins/Process/gdb-remote/ProcessGDBRemoteProperties.td and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/llvm-handoff-gdb-remote-timeout.md.

Commit message:
The Velmora boards are debugged over a serial-over-IP bridge (~1.5 s per round trip); while attaching the register-description replies take 6-8 s, so a 5 s packet timeout dropped the connection during attach.

writes.docs/decisions/llvm-handoff-gdb-remote-t:
# Why lldb/source/Plugins/Process/gdb-remote/ProcessGDBRemoteProperties.td holds this value

The Velmora boards are debugged over a serial-over-IP bridge (~1.5 s per round trip); while attaching the register-description replies take 6-8 s, so a 5 s packet timeout dropped the connection during attach.
